newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nissho Iwai unit sets yen bond due 2004.
newsitem.headline: Nissho Iwai unit sets yen bond due 2004.

text.p: The following step-up fixed rate note issue has been privately placed, said arranger DKB Asia on Friday.

A KEEPWELL AGREEMENT FROM NISSHO IWAI CORP. IT IS
LAUNCHED OFF THE BORROWER'S ASIAN DRAGON MEDIUM TERM
NOTE PROGRAMME SERIES 44.
